# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open an issue using the feature request template.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template. Include your versions and the exact error text.
- **OTX itself** (account issues, pulse content, indicator data): see [OTX](https://otx.alienvault.com/). This server only calls the OTX DirectConnect API.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately via [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/w0h1v/mcp-otx/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
